verdicts.reason: A keeps the original left-to-right strip with headline and subcopy on one left edge, but it reads as a stretched copy rather than a real reflow: a big gap separates the headline from its subcopy, the subcopy is tiny, the can is shrunk, and there's dead yellow above and below. B is worse: the enlarged headline floats in the top-left and doesn't line up with the subcopy (indented about 45px further right), and that same over-large gap pulls them apart. The can and controller sink to the bottom with an empty band above them, and the logo and CTA sit low on their own axis, so the layout looks bottom-heavy and arbitrary.
